variants.title: Donaldson P775300 Air Filter, Safety Radialseal | Replaces the HiFi Filter SA 16300
variants.option1: Donaldson P775300 Air Filter, Safety Radialseal | Replaces the HiFi Filter SA 16300
variants.brandDescription: Why Choose Donaldson Safety Filters? Safety filters have two functions: to act as a backup to the primary filter and to protect the engine during primary filter servicing. • Serve as a backup filter in case of primary filter damage or improper installation. • Prevent contaminants from entering the clean side of the air intake system during primary filter servicing. • Designed to plug rapidly if contamination finds its way past the primary filter, alerting operators about an issue. • Recommend that safety filters are replaced with every third primary filter change unless there has been a failure of the primary filter.

variants.option1: Mann Filter CF 850/2 Secondary Element | Replaces the HiFi Filter SA 16300
variants.brandDescription: High-quality MANN-FILTER air filter secondary elements offer a comprehensive protection against wear / Engine is protected even if the main filter component is replaced or damaged. While the main element is being replaced, extreme or dusty operating conditions can sometimes occur - the secondary element continues to provide optimum protection for a clean air.
